title: Machines Do See Color: A Guideline to Classify Different Forms of Racist Discourse in Large Corpora.
reasoning: The paper focuses on the methodological challenge of identifying and classifying racist discourse in social media corpora using NLP models like XLM-RoBERTa. While the subject of racism is an ethical and moral concern, the article aims to provide a sociopolitical and computational framework for classification rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, faith-based, or general moral/ethical systems.
